meta.comment: v0.38 = v0.37 minus the four homeless models (mistralai/mistral-small-2603, qwen/qwen3.5-flash-02-23 — eval underperformers; qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 — dedicated-only on Fireworks, absent from DeepInfra + Bedrock; qwen/qwen3-coder 480B-A35B — no SOC 2-compliant serverless home anywhere). Per-row provider on this snapshot reflects the bench-column source; the actual upstream chosen at runtime comes from internal/router/catalog (managed-prod pins to the SOC 2-compliant primary binding, self-hosters fall back to OpenRouter via the trailing binding). centroids.bin reused verbatim from v0.37 (clustering is model-independent); rankings.json + metadata.yaml stripped of the four dropped models. No retraining; PR 7 (v0.39) replaces this bundle once direct-provider pricing is baked into training.
